title: Provider bootstrap recipes carry one explicit activation source, revision, and digest
claim: Every Host Agent local provider bootstrap recipe that overrides opute.provider.install.recipeSource must pass the source, its exact immutable commit revision, and its SHA-256 from required recipe inputs. The Host Agent rejects a remote source whose explicit revision disagrees with the commit in its URL; provider descriptor fallback metadata never replaces the caller's revision.
rationale: A recipe that supplies a pinned raw GitHub URL and digest but omits revision can inherit a descriptor's working-tree revision. The Host Agent correctly rejects that mismatch, but only after earlier bootstrap nodes may have installed a binary and service.
owner: wunderous/host-agents owns provider bootstrap recipes, source parsing, and their typed regression evidence.

included: Host Agent local K3s provider installation recipe
Host Agent local Tailscale provider installation recipe
nested opute.provider.install actions with an explicit recipeSource override
remote raw GitHub source and exact commit revision matching
excluded: provider installs that use their descriptor's default source
source types without a declared immutable revision contract

exception: No remote source may inherit descriptor revision fallback when a recipe overrides recipeSource. Adding another source type requires an explicit typed source, revision, and content-digest contract with matching validation and regression evidence.

required: both bootstrap recipes require a lowercase 40-character activationRecipeRevision input
both nested provider install actions pass source, revision, and SHA-256 from those inputs
resolved plan arguments preserve the three supplied values together
the Host Agent parser accepts a matching URL revision and rejects a mismatch
the verifier checks file anchors and confirms CI reaches the regression tests

revisionBehavior: Bump each recipe's major version when the required provenance input contract changes. Recompute and review whole-file anchors when either recipe, source parser, regression test, Makefile verifier wiring, or CI test entry point changes.
